limits: reach is static and one-directional: a string names a module, never proves the module object it resolves to is the container the counted read line reads, so an import-string route is a route and not a demonstration

strings built from an expression (f-string with a value, str.format, percent formatting) are counted and published as unresolved rather than matched, so a computed route is outside this arm by construction
a string can reach a call through more assignments than the walk follows (8 hops); beyond that the consumer is published as no_call, which is a limit not a zero

face names are read from module-level assignments whose name is upper case and contains FACE or LATEST (FACE_NAME and UPSTREAM_FACE included, each published with its own constant name so an upstream face is never silently read as the module's own); a face assigned through a non-literal is published as face_constants_unmeasured, and a module that assigns none of the frozen names at all is published as face_constants_absent rather than as a zero spelling set
spellings are whole tokens of the measured name, so a literal that names only a family prefix ('e382' for 'e382_key_projection_delta') is not a match and is not counted
the read population is E638's join (one definition); a change to that join moves this study's pairs without touching its hits
files over 1MB are skipped rather than parsed (E391's cap) and are counted separately by the population this study re-derives
verdict: no hit module spells any counted read module, its stem, or its face in any string it can be asked to spell, so the importlib/path arm E646 could not see carries no hit either
